name: shutdown-timer
desc: Free, open-source shutdown scheduler for Windows — timed shutdown, restart, sleep and lock with cancel window. 100 MB portable, MIT.
features: ✅ **One-shot timers** — shutdown, restart, sleep, hibernate or lock after 15 minutes or any custom countdown
✅ **Daily schedules** — weekday and weekend rules for shutdown at 23:30 without Task Scheduler scripting
✅ **Cancel window** — a configurable 60-second countdown popup with a big cancel button before any action fires
✅ **Idle trigger** — run the action only when CPU and input have been quiet for N minutes, for render farms
✅ **Tray countdown** — remaining time lives in the tray tooltip so you never wonder when the machine dies
✅ **Command-line mode** — same binary accepts flags for shortcuts and scripts
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, portable, offline, MIT with SHA-256 releases
compare: | Feature | **shutdown-timer** | Wise Auto Shutdown | Task Scheduler | Shutdown Timer |
| Cancel countdown popup | **Yes** | Basic | No | No |
| Tray countdown display | **Yes** | Yes | No | No |
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Installer | With OS | Zip |
faqQ: how to schedule automatic shutdown on Windows 10 and 11?
faqA: The built-in way is a shutdown dash-s slash-t command or a Task Scheduler chain that is easy to misconfigure and hard to cancel. shutdown-timer gives the same power with a visible countdown and a cancel window, plus idle-triggered actions Task Scheduler cannot do natively. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline, with no telemetry.
s1: Dark main window (#12141A, moonlit blue #93C5FD): action selector with five icons, countdown input 45 minutes, big Start Timer button.
s2: Schedule tab: weekday and weekend rows, time pickers at 23:30 and 01:00, exception list for video calls, enabled toggles green.
s3: Firing countdown: full-screen dimmed popup, 60 s ring animation, Cancel This Shutdown button focused, tray mirroring the counter.
